description: Saldo Pocket is a budget app for iOS and Android. Your budget is stored on your phone: there is no bank connection, and we do not have a copy of your data.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what Saldo Pocket stores, what it sends and to whom, and what you can do about it. The short version: your budget stays on your phone.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
body: {{company}} (org. no. {{orgNumber}}, {{country}}) is responsible for the processing described here. Contact us at {{email}}.

sections.heading: In short
list: Your budget is stored on your phone. Without an account, we cannot see it.
An account is optional (Apple, Google, Facebook or e-mail). With an account and Pro, your budget is synced to our server in the EU so you can use it on several devices.
There is no bank connection.
CSV and Excel files from your bank are read only on your phone. The file itself is never stored, copied or sent anywhere.
Nothing from your budget leaves the phone unless you sync with Pro or choose AI reading of a statement, receipt or bill.
Crash reports contain no personal data.
You can export everything and delete everything in the app, for free.

sections.heading: Stored on your phone
body: The app stores this in its own storage on your phone. It is not sent to us, and it is deleted when you delete all data in the app or uninstall it:
list: The accounts you create (names you choose, balance and currency; not bank accounts).
Your entries: date, amount, currency, category, vendor and an optional note.
Recurring items, savings goals, your own categories, and the category remembered for each vendor.
Settings: payday, monthly budget, your language and currency, and whether you allow AI reading.
A random device ID, used only to count AI readings (see below).
Pictures you choose to keep after an import.
after: KID numbers are never stored, and neither is the full account number. The app may store the last four digits of the account number to recognize the account.

sections.heading: Importing CSV and Excel files
body: When you import a CSV or Excel file from your bank, the file is read only on your phone. The file itself is never stored, copied or sent anywhere – not to a server and not to AI.

From the file, the app stores only the date (and the booking date when the file has one), description, amount, vendor, the bank’s balance for reconciling the account, and the last four digits of the account number, to recognize the account. KID numbers, other references and the file’s other columns are not stored.

Entries the bank has not booked yet are stored as ordinary entries and counted straight away. If such an entry is missing from a later import from your bank, the app asks whether you want to remove it. It is never removed by itself.
The app remembers how the columns in the file are laid out, without their content, so the next import is quicker. When you are signed in with Pro, this is synced with your other settings.
AI reading is used only for pictures and PDFs, and only when you have said yes.

sections.heading: AI reading of transaction lists, receipts and bills (optional)
body: When you import a screenshot or photo of a transaction list from your bank, or scan a receipt or bill, you can let AI read it. The app asks for your permission first, and you can turn it off at any time on the import screen. Without permission, everything is read on the phone and nothing is sent.

With permission, the picture (or the text read from it), the currency, your country, today’s date, the app’s list of categories and the device ID are sent through {{server}} to Anthropic, which reads the rows with its AI model (Claude) and sends them back. Neither we nor Supabase store the picture, the text or the rows. Anthropic does not use data sent through its API to train its models, and deletes it after a limited time under its own terms.

To keep the service within its limits (a limited number of readings per device), our server stores the device ID, the date and the number of readings, and nothing else. These counts are deleted automatically after 30 days.

For the free version’s limit on AI scans, our server counts scans per month with a hashed device ID – a one-way code made from the phone’s ID with a secret key, never the ID itself. The hashed device ID is used only to count free AI scans, not for tracking. Only the code, the month and the number are stored, and the count is deleted automatically after 13 months.

sections.heading: Scanning receipts and bills
body: When you scan a receipt or bill, the picture is read on your phone, or by AI if you have said yes (see above). The picture is deleted as soon as it has been read, even if you cancel or something goes wrong. From the picture, only the store, date, amount and category are stored. KID numbers and account numbers are never stored.

sections.heading: Crash reports
body: When the app crashes or an error occurs, a report is sent to Sentry (in the EU): what went wrong and where in the app, the app version, and the phone model and system version. Collection of personal data, such as IP address or user identity, is turned off. Reports are kept for at most 90 days and are used only to fix errors.

sections.heading: App updates
body: The app checks for updates from Expo, the service that delivers them. As with any connection to the internet, Expo sees the phone’s IP address. No other data is sent.

sections.heading: Buying Pro
body: Pro is bought in the App Store or Google Play. Apple or Google handles the payment under their own privacy policies; we never see your card details. RevenueCat keeps track of whether you have Pro, with an anonymous ID the app makes, or your account ID when you are signed in, so Pro follows your account.

sections.heading: Optional account and sync (Pro)
body: You can sign in with Apple, Google, Facebook (Meta) or e-mail. Sign-in is handled by Supabase on servers in {{region}}. We then store your e-mail address, an account ID, your name if the provider shares it, your app language and, on test versions, a test flag. With Apple you can hide your e-mail address; we then only see Apple’s relay address.

With Pro, your budget is synced to your account: accounts, entries, recurring items, budget, savings goals, your own categories, remembered vendors and the settings that follow you (payday, salary, budget). Each change is stored with when it was made and on which device. The data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and only your account can read it.

Sign-in codes and links are sent by e-mail through Resend, with your address and language. To send each e-mail once, the server keeps only the message ID, type and status for 7 days, never the address.
You can sign out at any time; the data stays on the phone. “Delete account” removes the account and all data stored with it on the server.

sections.heading: Widget and reminders
body: The widget shows numbers from the data on your phone, and reminders for recurring items are set up on your phone. Nothing is sent for either.

sections.heading: Who we share data with
list: Supabase (Ireland, EU): sign-in, sync for Pro, and the server for AI reading and its count.
Anthropic (USA): AI reading, only with your permission.
Resend (USA): e-mails with sign-in codes and links.
RevenueCat (USA): purchases of Pro.
Sentry (EU): crash reports without personal data.
Expo (USA): app updates.
Apple, Google and Meta: the App Store, Google Play and signing in with them, when you choose to.
after: Where data goes to the USA, the providers use the EU standard contractual clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. We never sell data, and the app has no ads and no tracking.

sections.heading: Legal basis
list: To provide the app you use (GDPR article 6(1)(b)).
Your consent for AI reading (article 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw it at any time.
Our legitimate interest in fixing errors and keeping the service within its limits (article 6(1)(f)).

sections.heading: How long data is kept
list: On the phone: until you delete it in the app or uninstall the app.
Your account and synced data: until you delete the account in the app.
Pictures and text for AI reading: not stored by us.
CSV and Excel files you import: not stored. Only the entries you save and the layout of the file’s columns remain.
Count of AI readings: 30 days.
Count of free AI scans (hashed device ID, month and number): 13 months.
Log of sign-in e-mails (no address): 7 days.
Crash reports: at most 90 days.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can see, correct and export all your data in the app (Me → Export data, free for everyone), and delete it (Me → Delete all data). You can object to processing and withdraw your consent for AI reading at any time.

If you have questions, write to {{email}}. The supervisory authority is the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet), and you can complain to it. If you live in the EU/EEA, you can also complain to the data protection authority in your own country.

sections.heading: Children
body: Saldo Pocket is not made for children under 13, and we do not knowingly process their data.

sections.heading: Changes
body: If we change this policy, we update this page and the date at the top. If the change matters for how your data is used, we tell you in the app.

deleteAccount.intro: Your Saldo Pocket data is stored on your phone, so you delete it yourself in the app. No request is needed.

sections.heading: Delete everything in the app
body: This deletes everything the app keeps on your phone: accounts, entries, recurring items, goals, categories, vendors, settings, saved pictures and files, the device ID, and your language and currency choices. The app then starts over from scratch.
The count of free scans and file imports stays – only numbers, nothing about you or your data – both on the phone and on our server, so the free limit still applies.
It cannot be undone. If you want a copy, export your data first under Me → Export data. It is free.

sections.heading: Uninstalling the app
body: Uninstalling Saldo Pocket also deletes all its data from your phone.
Exception: the count of free scans and file imports (only numbers) may stay in the phone’s keychain (iPhone) or in Android’s backup, so the free limit also applies after a new install.

sections.heading: What is left on our server
body: If you have used AI reading, our server keeps a count of readings per device ID and day, without any content. It is deleted automatically after 30 days. The device ID is random and is deleted from your phone with everything else, so the count cannot be linked to you.

Free AI scans are also counted per month with a hashed device ID (a one-way code, never the ID itself). The hashed device ID is used only to count free AI scans, not for tracking, and the count is deleted automatically after 13 months.

sections.heading: Deleting your account
body: If you use the app without signing in, your data is only on your phone. It is deleted when you delete all data in the app, or when you remove the app from your phone.

If you are signed in, your data in the cloud is also deleted when you delete your account in the app: the account, everything synced to it, and everything on the phone you delete from. If you signed in with Facebook, what we received from Facebook is deleted too. You can also remove Saldo Pocket in your Facebook settings.

If you only delete the data on your phone, you are signed out, but your account and your data in the cloud stay. Data on your other devices is not deleted automatically; delete it in the app there. Deleting does not cancel a subscription; you do that in the App Store or Google Play.

sections.heading: If you no longer have the app
body: Write to {{email}} with the subject “Delete Saldo Pocket data”. We answer within 30 days. Because there is no account, we usually have nothing stored about you, and we will confirm that.

support.intro: Questions, problems or ideas? Write to us and we will answer as soon as we can.
support.contactBody: E-mail {{email}}. Please tell us your phone model and the app version (at the bottom of Me).
support.proNote: See Pro in the app for what is included.

faq.q: How do I restore my purchase on a new phone?
faq.a: Pro is tied to your Apple ID or Google account. Sign in with the same account on the new phone, open Saldo Pocket and tap Restore purchases.

faq.q: How do I export my data?
faq.a: Go to Me → Export data. Export all my data (JSON or CSV) is free for everyone.

faq.q: How do I import from my online bank?
faq.a: Tap + and choose how you want to bring in your transactions (screenshots or a file from your online bank). You review every row before anything is saved, and rows you already have are marked. Saldo Pocket never connects to your bank.

faq.q: How do I delete my data?
faq.a: Go to Me → Delete all data. Everything on the phone is deleted. Read more on the page about deleting your data.

terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Saldo Pocket, a budgeting app from {{company}}. By using the app, you accept them.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: {{company}} (org. no. {{orgNumber}}, {{country}}) makes and runs Saldo Pocket. Contact us at {{email}}.

sections.heading: What the app is
body: Saldo Pocket gives you an overview of your money: accounts, entries, budget and goals. The figures are based on what you enter and import. They are an overview, not financial advice, so check important decisions with your bank.

sections.heading: Account and sync
body: You can use the app without an account. If you sign in and have Pro, your data is synced to your account so you can use it on several devices. Keep your sign-in safe; anyone who can sign in to your account can see the synced data.

sections.heading: Free and Pro
body: The free version costs nothing. Pro is bought in the App Store or Google Play, as a subscription (monthly or yearly) or as a one-time purchase. The price is shown in the store before you buy.
list: A subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in the store at least 24 hours before the period ends.
You manage and cancel it in your App Store or Google Play account settings.
If a free trial is offered, it turns into a paid subscription when it ends unless you cancel before then.

sections.heading: The stores’ terms
body: Purchases on iPhone and iPad also follow Apple’s standard license agreement (EULA), and purchases on Android follow Google Play’s terms. Refunds are handled by the store you bought from.

sections.heading: Your data
body: Your data is yours. You can export it and delete it in the app at any time, even on the free version. How we handle personal data is described in the privacy policy.

sections.heading: Responsibility
body: We work to keep the app correct and available, but it is provided as is. As far as the law allows, we are not responsible for indirect losses. Your rights as a consumer are not limited by these terms.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may update these terms. Important changes are shown in the app or on this page, with the date at the top.

sections.heading: Law
body: These terms are governed by Norwegian law. If you are a consumer, you also keep the protection given to you by the law of the country where you live.

authCallback.codeHint: Not on the phone with the app? Open Saldo Pocket there and enter the code from the e-mail instead.

authCallback.desktopTitle: Open the link on your phone
authCallback.desktopBody: This link can’t sign you in here. Open it on the phone where Saldo Pocket is installed, or enter the code from the e-mail in the app.
